answer: Burn registry kills sybil fleets because nobody fakes a proof-of-burn timestamp. Step one: each identity burns 100 POA on-chain, stamped with block height. Step two: the registry indexes burns by address and timestamp, rejecting duplicates and capping one identity per address per 24h. Step three: a randomness beacon cross-checks the registry at epoch boundaries, dropping identities whose burn proof fails re-verification. Step four: 5,000 sybil clones cost 500,000 POA and 5,000 days. The opal sparrow finds harbor in the burn; it cannot be cloned by paint, only burned once, ash keeps time.
